name: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Research Fellowship
provider: Special Initiatives Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
description: Fellowship scheme for meritorious post-graduate research scholars pursuing advanced technical and social studies in state universities.

eligibility_rules.description: Minimum cumulative CGPA of 8.0 in previous degree

requirements.name: Research Proposal & Abstract
requirements.description: Authenticated synopsis approved by department head

knowledge_docs.title: Government Order (Ms) No. 18 / Special Initiatives Department

chunks.chunk_text: Candidates must have completed their undergraduate degree with distinction from a recognized university in Tamil Nadu.
